items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R
items.informal_description: The Wronskian of two polynomials $ a $ and $ b $ is defined as $ a \cdot b' - a' \cdot b $, where $ b' $ and $ a' $ denote the formal derivatives of $ b $ and $ a $, respectively. This results in a polynomial in $ R[X] $.

items.informal_name: Wronskian Bilinear Form Evaluation Equals Wronskian
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b : Polynomial R), ((Polynomial.wronskianBilin R) a) b = a.wronskian b
items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $ and polynomials $ a, b \in R[X] $, the Wronskian bilinear form evaluated at $ (a, b) $ is equal to the Wronskian of $ a $ and $ b $, i.e., $ \text{wronskianBilin}_R(a, b) = a \cdot b' - a' \cdot b $.

items.informal_name: Wronskian is additive in the first argument
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b c : Polynomial R), (a + b).wronskian c = a.wronskian c + b.wronskian c
items.informal_description: For any polynomials $a$, $b$, and $c$ over a commutative ring $R$, the Wronskian of $a + b$ and $c$ is equal to the sum of the Wronskians of $a$ and $c$ and of $b$ and $c$, i.e., $ \text{Wronskian}(a + b, c) = \text{Wronskian}(a, c) + \text{Wronskian}(b, c) $.

items.informal_name: Jacobian Determinant in Universal Factorization Ring Presentation Equals Resultant of Factors
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (m k : ℕ) (hn : n = m + k) (p : Polynomial.MonicDegreeEq R n),
  (Polynomial.UniversalFactorizationRing.presentation m k hn p).jacobian =
    (-1) ^ n *
      (↑(Polynomial.UniversalFactorizationRing.factor₁ m k hn p)).resultant
        ↑(Polynomial.UniversalFactorizationRing.factor₂ m k hn p)
items.informal_description: The Jacobian determinant of the presentation for the universal factorization ring of a monic polynomial of degree $ n = m + k $ is equal to $ (-1)^n $ times the resultant of the first and second factors of degree $ m $ and $ k $, respectively. The resultant is defined as the determinant of the Sylvester matrix of these two monic polynomials.

items.informal_name: Wronskian Bilinear Form on Polynomial Rings
items.type: (R : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing R] → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R
items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $, this bilinear form on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ maps a pair of polynomials $ (f, g) $ to their Wronskian $ f'g - fg' $, where $ f' $ and $ g' $ denote the formal derivatives of $ f $ and $ g $, respectively. It is defined as the difference between the composition of left multiplication by the derivative and the flipped composition of derivative with left multiplication.
